newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Auctions of 2 Russian energy firms to start July 2.
newsitem.headline: Auctions of 2 Russian energy firms to start July 2.

text.p: Auctions of government stakes in Russian oil firms KomiTEK and the East-Siberian Oil and Gas Company will start on July 2, a State Property Fund official said on Friday.
"The auctions of two companies -- KomiTEK and East-Siberian -- will start on July 2," Maria Mironova, head of the fund's information department, told Reuters.
Mironova said the starting date for auctions of state stakes in four other energy companies due to be privatised had yet to be agreed.
Privatisation Minister Alfred Kokh said on Wednesday government stakes in the six companies would be auctioned beginning early next month.

The sales are part of Moscow's drive to raise up to $1 billion fast for the cash-strapped budget and reflect aggressive privatisation of the oil sector in Russia, the world's third largest oil producer.
The companies on offer in addition to KomiTEK and East-Siberian Oil and Gas are the Tyumen Oil Company, Eastern Oil Company, Norsi-Oil and the Siberian-Urals Oil Company (SIBUR).
